messages:
sasha: Kicking off release 2024.03.15 into the 02:00 UTC change window. Plan: pin api/runtime/console/router and roll canary 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Need quick ack and any hard constraints.

carmen: Ack from console. Minor schema opt-in (telemetry field) — tested on staging. No DB migrations.

liam: API team ack. Runtime note: v2.4.3 has the new kernel selection — we've run perf seats but keep emergency fallback to v2.4.1 available. Recommend runtime@v2.4.3 + quant-profile=default-fallback.

zane: Router ack. We'll keep header-splitting flag OFF for the first canary slice. Toggle is prepped.

sasha: @deploy-bot please create canary with pins: api@v1.12.0 runtime@v2.4.3 console@v0.9.1 router@v3.2.0. Canary policy 2%/20%/100%. Rollback thresholds: errors >0.5% or p95 +200ms vs baseline. Start in 10m.

deploy-bot: Created canary run id=canary-20240315-01; targets: api@v1.12.0 runtime@v2.4.3 console@v0.9.1 router@v3.2.0; policy: 2%->20%->100%; thresholds: errors>0.5% || p95>baseline+200ms. Scheduled start: in 10m.

liam: small correction — for the tiny 2% slice let's use a slightly higher error threshold to avoid noisy aborts: errors>1% for 2% canary, then errors>0.5% at 20%+; absolute p95 cutoff set to 500ms.

ops: Observability checklist done: canary tag on traces, logs routed to canary workspace, synthetic probe running against API endpoints. I'll own rollback authority during the window until 03:30 UTC.

carmen: Release notes draft: "console: telemetry adds optional backend_version field; no user-facing changes. Performance tuning under the hood." I'll drop it in the release-notes doc in 5m.

sasha: Good. Who is the rollback playbook owner if ops triggers? @carmen?

ops: I'll coordinate the rollback but want the runtime team (liam) to approve fallback image if needed. Carmen prepare the 'undo' console bundle (config toggle).

liam: Understood. Fallback command prepared:

```
# rollback to stable
/deploy rollback --run-id canary-20240315-01 --services runtime,api,console,router --to-tag stable-20240308
```

liam: Will also have a hot patch image runtime@v2.4.1-ready in the registry.

deploy-bot: Canary started (canary-20240315-01) — 2% traffic slice in progress. Start time: 2024-03-15T02:10:00Z. Monitoring hooks enabled.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics update: error_rate=0.12% (2% slice), p95=220ms (vs baseline 210ms) — within thresholds. Proceeding to scale to 20% in 3m unless any hold requests.

zane: Holding router changes at 2% until 20% completes. Will flip header-split flag only after 20% is healthy.

carmen: :thumbsup: logging looks clean. No schema regressions in the sample.

ops: Watching dashboards — no SLO regressions. I won't abort.

sasha: Thanks all. If anything spikes (errors >1% at 2% or p95>500ms) call the abort in this thread and ops will run the rollback command. Otherwise we move to 100% after 20% soak.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 20% — complete. Monitoring continues. Next automatic step: 100% in 10m if thresholds remain green.

liam: I'm going to stay online for the next 30m. Ping me if anything odd.

ops: Noted. I'll post a final gate message before 100% shift.

sasha: Final - thanks team. I'll update the release notes with the runtime fallback note and pin list.

deploy-bot: Canary run canary-20240315-01 remains healthy at 20% after 10m. No rollback triggered. Scheduled 100% shift in 6m.

zane: ready to toggle router flag post-100%.

ops: Holding rollback authority until 03:30 UTC as announced.

sasha: Closing coordination here — will post a follow-up when 100% is done.
